sandbachFocus: Sandbach United, currently top of the table with 22 points from 10 games, face Alsager Town at home on Saturday 3 October at 15:00. Sandbach arrive in mixed form after a recent loss, though they have won 7 games this season. Alsager are bottom of the division with just 4 points and have won only once all season, making this a fixture where the leaders will be heavy favourites.
divisionWide: Stafford Town (second, 20 points) travel to Dawley Town in a match between mid-table sides. AFC Bridgnorth host Eccleshall in a clash between third and fifth place — both teams are in strong positions despite recent losses for Bridgnorth. Wolverhampton Casuals welcome Wednesfield Community on Saturday, with the visitors also featuring in a midweek trip to Brereton Social on Wednesday 7 October. Bilston Town host Foley Meir in a contest between seventh and thirteenth in the league. Market Drayton Town entertain New Mills, with the hosts seeking to climb away from the relegation zone after recent losses. Brereton Social face Widnes Town at home; both sides are struggling, with Widnes pointless at the bottom. Crewe host Allscott Heath in a basement battle. Shawbury United visit Barnton as the hosts look to push up the table. Cheadle Heath Nomads travel to Telford Town in a fixture between two of the division's weakest teams. The midweek fixture on Wednesday sees Brereton Social host Wednesfield Community at 19:45.
